ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-contrast white localized punctate marks. Ratio is approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Numerous white annular (ring-shaped) and solid circular blobs ranging from 5 to 30 pixels in diameter. Notable clusters are present in the interior left lobe and scattered sparsely across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 1/8th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary with peak-to-valley amplitudes of 10-20 pixels. Serration density increases significantly towards the lateral extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of white ring-like pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the mid-sections of both lobes, with higher density on the left lobe's upper quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, fine-line white linear disruptions are visible near the peduncle-fluke junction and vertically oriented scratches on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of 3D high-contrast white barnacle colonies localized at the distal tips and along portions of the leading edge, obscuring natural pigmentation in those regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct and symmetrical distribution of heavy barnacle clusters on the extreme lateral points of both fluke lobes.
